# third_party/

Vendored code and assets copied from other open-source projects live here, one
folder per source, each containing the original `LICENSE` file unchanged.

Rules:

- Only GPL-compatible code (GPL, LGPL, MIT, BSD, Apache-2.0, ISC). **No AGPL
  code** — its network clause would bind this web app.
- Assets (piece sets, sounds) must carry a clear license; honour attribution
  and any share-alike terms.
- Every folder added here also gets a row in the top-level `CREDITS.md`.

Nothing is vendored yet — see `docs/OPEN_SOURCE_SURVEY.md` for the shortlist.
